title: Quantum Phase Diagram of the $2+1$D Untruncated SU$(2)$ Lattice Gauge Theory with Dynamical Fermions
summary: Non-Abelian gauge theories with dynamical matter govern the strong interaction and a broad class of strongly correlated quantum systems, yet their ground-state properties remain difficult to obtain from first principles. Using a continuous-group variational Monte Carlo approach that retains the full SU$(2)$ gauge field without truncation, we determine the ground-state behavior of the SU$(2)$ lattice gauge theory with staggered fermions on an $L\times L$ square lattice.
